reason: A session-aware DSH file manager that browses workspace files, displays Git status, and previews text, images, and videos through read-only host interfaces.

summaries.zh: 面向 DSH 会话工作区提供文件树、Git 状态以及文本、图片和视频预览的文件管理器插件。
summaries.en: A DSH session file manager that provides workspace browsing, Git status views, and previews for text, image, and video files.

capabilities: Read bounded text and media files for browser previews
Read Git status and changed-file metadata
Open session-linked file references in an integrated preview
